source.title: WMT Leader Announcement (September 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce that Chenxi Shan will become the new Leader of the WCA Marketing Team (WMT). Chenxi was already working as a Member of the WCT and the WMCT.
<!-- break -->

Chenxi was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams. This appointment is effective as of September 27, 2026.

We wish Chenxi the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Chenxi was one of the two applications we received. You can view all the candidacy documents [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15F6KJHuctq4vk3zOaFbVBAVqthx4fHu9?usp=drive_link).

translation.title: WCA 市场营销组负责人任命公告（2026 年 9 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴宣布，Chenxi Shan 将担任 WCA 市场营销组（WMT）的新任负责人。Chenxi 此前已是 WCT 和 WMCT 的成员。

WCA 董事会依据《WCA 委员会与团队[议案](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf)》第 5 节，选出 Chenxi，并通过投票批准了这一任命。任命自 2026 年 9 月 27 日生效。

我们祝 Chenxi 在新的岗位上一切顺利。

我们共收到两份申请，Chenxi 是其中一位申请人。所有申请材料均可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15F6KJHuctq4vk3zOaFbVBAVqthx4fHu9?usp=drive_link)查看。
